title: Component testing vs integration testing
description: Learn about Component testing vs integration testing. Master the concepts, patterns, and best practices.

data.text: **Component testing vs integration testing** is an essential topic for senior engineers. In this lesson, you will learn the core concepts, practical applications, and common pitfalls associated with component testing vs integration testing.

items: Understand the core differences between component testing and integration testing
Know when to choose component testing over integration testing
Recognize the trade-offs involved in each approach
Apply the right tool for the specific problem context

data.text: Understanding component testing vs integration testing is critical for building robust systems. It helps you make better architectural decisions, write cleaner code, and troubleshoot issues more effectively in production environments.

data.title: Pro Tip
data.text: When working with component testing vs integration testing, always consider the trade-offs. The right approach depends on your specific context, team expertise, and system requirements.
